formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (n : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (c a b : ℕ) (sigma : ℕ → ℕ), PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C → c < C.gates.length → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C c).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C c).inputs = [a, b] → (∀ r ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.readers n C c, sigma r = a ∨ sigma r = b) → (∀ g ∈ PEqualNP.FactorSubst.frontier n C c, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C g).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → ∀ u y : ℕ, ((PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C g).inputs = [u, y] ∨ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C g).inputs = [y, u]) → (∃ w ∈ insert c (PEqualNP.FactorSubst.orClosure n C c), u = n + w) → (∀ w' ∈ insert c (PEqualNP.FactorSubst.orClosure n C c), y ≠ n + w') ∧ ∀ r ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.readers n C c, (r = g ∨ PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.OrReaches n C u r) → (sigma r = b → ∀ x : Fin n → Bool, PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.wireVal n C y x = true → PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.wireVal n C a x = true) ∧ (sigma r = a → ∀ x' : Fin n → Bool, PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.wireVal n C y x' = true → PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.wireVal n C b x' = true)) → (∀ g2 ∈ PEqualNP.FactorSubst.frontier n C c, ∀ u2 ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C g2).inputs, ∀ r1 ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.readers n C c, ∀ r2 ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.readers n C c, PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.OrReaches n C u2 r1 → PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.OrReaches n C u2 r2 → sigma r1 = sigma r2) → (∀ w3 ∈ insert c (PEqualNP.FactorSubst.orClosure n C c), C.output ≠ n + w3) → c ∈ PEqualNP.FactorSubst.liveGates n C → (∀ k < C.gates.length, k ≠ c → k ∉ PEqualNP.FactorSubst.orClosure n C c → ∀ z : Fin n → Bool, PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.gateVal n (PEqualNP.FactorSubst.substReads C n c sigma) k z = PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.gateVal n C k z) ∧ PEqualNP.FactorSubst.liveSize n (PEqualNP.FactorSubst.substReads C n c sigma) + 1 ≤ PEqualNP.FactorSubst.liveSize n C)
plain_statement: It is false that: AND/OR circuit, each gate reading exactly two earlier wires; c an AND of a, b; O the gates c reaches by OR paths; sigma picks a or b per reader of c. If every AND reading u in O+c has other input y outside O+c, y<=a where a reader below u picks b, y<=b where one picks a (H1), readers below each u agree (H2), the output is outside O+c and c is live (H3): rewriting c's reads by sigma keeps every gate outside O+c and cuts the LIVE size (gates the output uses) by >=1. Not claimed: live size = size for least circuits. Not covered: y below neither factor; ANDs on one O gate picking
title: It is false that: Factor substitution, exact fan-in-two AND/OR: an AND whose AND readers' partners lie below the factor not picked is bypassed, live size down >
